title: Caring for Earth
seo_title: Kindergarten Caring for Earth Worksheets: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
standard_text: Communicate solutions that will reduce the impact of humans on the land, water, air, and/or other living things in the local environment.
meta_desc: Free kindergarten science worksheets on caring for Earth (NGSS K-ESS3-3): reduce, reuse and recycle, saving water and energy, and solving problems in your neighborhood. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: We can take care of Earth.
key_sub: Reduce, reuse, recycle. Save water. Pick up litter.
body_html:
How to think about it

We can take care of Earth.

  • Reduce: use less.
  • Reuse: use it again. Recycle: make it new.
  • Pick up litter and plant trees.
Example

Where does used paper go?

Paper can be made new.

Answer: the recycling bin

Example

Water is running while you brush. What should you do?

Use less water.

Answer: turn it off

Common mistakes

  • Thinking small trash on the ground is OK.
  • Leaving the water running.
  • Putting everything in the trash.

faq.q: What do reduce, reuse and recycle mean?
faq.a: Reduce means use less, reuse means use something again, and recycle means make old things into new things.
Turn off water and lights, pick up litter, plant trees, compost food scraps and use cloth bags.
People change the land, water and air. Small choices help keep them clean for people, plants and animals.
